lines.en: One spring carries me several blocks.
My hind legs gather, then release.
Grass blades bend beneath my feet.
I land on another leaf.
Short wings, but long jumps.
A hop to each stride, steady rhythm.
I kick up grains of soil.

lines.zh: 平原上的草刚好到我膝
lines.en: The plains grass reaches my knees.
I spring around a clump of mugwort.
My antennae swing with every hop.

lines.zh: 我落在石头上，滑了一下
lines.en: I land on a stone and slip.
My shadow hops along the ground.
I face forward, legs trailing behind.
I listen to the sounds in the grass.
I work my way up the rise.
Hopping suits me better than walking.
I land on the crest and look back.
My legs rebound the moment they land.
I perch on the tip of a blade.
My hind legs fold into sharp angles.
I rub my wings with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 我把一条前腿举到嘴边
lines.en: I hold one foreleg to my mouth.
I grind my mandibles on a stem.
The wind on the plains is strong.
I wait for the ground to tremble.
Sunlight shows through my wings.
The shell on my head is hard.
I am working my mouthparts.
I turn my head slowly.
I feel like moving again.
Both my compound eyes lock onto you.
Crouch, and I can see you clearly.
My eyes sit on the sides of my head.
Are you trying to catch me?
My hind legs are already wound.
One more step and I spring.
My color suits the grass.
You block the sun, and the grass goes dark.
I raise my front legs and wave them.
These wings are poor fliers.
One jump puts me behind you.
My sound comes from my legs.
I spring far away.
One hind leg will not work.
There is a crack in my shell.
I hide at the grass roots.
I make no sound, and cannot.
My shell split; I hop dragging a leg.
I can still jump.
One antenna is bent.
I tremble in the grass.
My hind leg is bent; I can't jump.
That leaf looks tender.
I move in close to sniff.
This is not quite edible.
Just set it down, do not pass it.
I nibble the leaf beside it.
This bite is quite good.
Do you have other leaves?
The vein is thick, so I gnaw around it.
I will hop off when I finish.
I am not greedy for more.
I bite the tender edge right off.
Leave the rest behind.
I'm knocked over to the grass roots.
My hind legs fire and I spring clear.
Our collision shakes the grass.
Your heel presses my leg.
I spring up onto higher ground.
That snapped off an antenna.
I look for a place in the grass.
I have not found my footing.
Do not grind this patch of grass.
I have sprung to your side.
My hind legs can make a sound.
There are many of us on the plains.
We spring together.
There are plenty of spots in the grass.
The highest jumper goes.
There are leaves enough for us.
My color shifts a little.
On the plain we hop as a pair.
Once airborne, we are hard to catch.
Let us go back to the leaves.
My front legs are too thin to hold it.
It is heavier than a leaf.
I bite it; too hard.
I shove it off with a foreleg.
It rolled to the grass roots.
I cannot carry it.
I clamp it behind my knee.
This thing rattles.
Not food, so I leave it.
I hopped over for a look.
First I spring a stretch away.
I am watching your hands.
I hide in the knee-high grass.
I can spring clear any moment.

lines.zh: 你手还没落下我就弹走
lines.en: I spring away before your hand falls.
I have picked my direction.
I dislike being pinned.
I am ready to spring.
One stir of the grass and I know.
I know this meadow well.
You are not yet close enough to reach.
I hear your soles.
I follow you, hop by hop.
Each time you reach, I give ground.
The grass is too tall; you cannot see clearly.
I am at your rear diagonal.
One more jump and I am far off.
My legs still have plenty in them.
My hind legs still have strength.
You circle; I spring past.
We circle each other in the grass.

lines.zh: 你听见蹬地的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the kick of my legs?
I pause, then spring again.
The more you hurry, the steadier I am.
The spines on my hind leg rake past.
The spines on my hind leg rake past.
That spring carried me far.
I land on your shoulder.
I do not bite; I spring.
I kick loose, only wanting to run.
I have sprung away again.
Your armor is too slick.
I lose my footing and tumble.
I hurry away in a jump.
I spring up out of the grass.
The wind on the plains is stiff.
First I hop twice to test my legs.
There are leaves enough here to eat.
I land on a tall blade of grass.
Low grass everywhere around.
My color follows the grass.
Companions are hopping in the distance.
I fold my legs up.
Nothing else large in this patch.
I stand facing the sun.
Wind bends my antennae to one side.
The fire passes and both grass and I are scorched.
I land badly and tumble over.
I tumble head over heels in the water.
The blast throws me high.
Something passes through my wing.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的腿僵住
lines.en: That force locks my legs.
Hungry enough to chew dry grass.
One strike and my legs go rigid.
There is no grass here to kick against.
